comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
Having said that, it is worth noting that Savaii, a Private Farm in the Pacific/Oceania region, has the potential to produce this good. You can investigate the details more fully in this section:

Private Farm

The link to the Private Farm section is also on the front page, yet easy to miss at the bottom beneath all the comments.

comments.author: fable17
comments.body: with a certain chrono title u can make improved rope by the Adventurer npc in venice...which seems totally useless if u can get the sisal in veracruze and make it there :(

comments.author: WW
comments.body:
Well not totally useless. In order to make Improved rope you would have to go to Veracruz, which can be dangerous if the waters are unsafe. A safer option would be to go to Willemstad or Caracas, buy the sisal and then go back to Venice to make the rope.

It would take longer, and I don't really recommend it, but it is the safer way.

comments.author: Taipan
comments.body:
There's also a recipe for making Sisal in the "Fabric secrets- Hardwares" book, 5 Large Leaves -> 1-2 Sisal. The book is availble at the Shopkeeper in all 6 Starter Cities, and every farm islands has plots that can produce Large Leaves.
